enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing and getting ready for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast while checking the weather forecast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour milk into bowl. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Melt butter. Pour egg mixture into pan. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pick up fork. Eat. Pick up phone. Open weather app. Check forecast. Close app. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag and reviewing patient notes on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open work bag. Place stethoscope into bag. Place notebook into bag. Place pen into bag. Zip bag. Sit at desk. Open computer. Log in. Open patient notes. Read notes. Scroll down. Make notes on paper. Close computer. Stand. Pick up work bag.

Pick up work bag. Walk to front door. Open door. Walk out. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working shift at the hospital, providing patient care, rounds and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward. Check patient list. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes on computer. Attend rounds. Discuss cases with colleagues. Walk to next patient. Wash hands. Enter another patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to nurses station. Use computer. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Retrieve supplies. Walk back to ward. Restock supplies. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Record notes. Walk to break room. Sit down. Eat lunch. Stand up. Walk to ward. Continue patient care. Attend afternoon rounds. Document notes. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs.

Exit hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take off scrubs. Put scrubs in hamper. Put on t-shirt. Put on sweatpants. Close closet.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Turn off stove. Pour soup into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat soup. Finish eating. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up, loading the dishwasher and filling water bottles ahead of the storm
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Open cupboard. Take out water bottles. Walk to sink. Fill bottles with water. Cap bottles. Place bottles in refrigerator. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Put down remote. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Throw away snack wrapper. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging phone and computer, closing windows and preparing for a possible power outage
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone charger. Plug charger into wall outlet. Connect phone to charger. Pick up computer charger. Plug charger into wall outlet. Connect computer to charger. Walk to living room. Close window. Lock window. Walk to bedroom. Close window. Lock window. Pick up flashlight. Press button to test. Turn off flashlight. Place flashlight on nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Walk back to bedroom. Sit on bed. Turn off TV. Lie down. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Remain asleep.
